description: Mido and the forest exit stop blocking Link, as child or adult
label: Open Forest

description: The Kakariko gate guard has already seen Zelda's letter, so the Death Mountain trail is open from the start
label: Open Kakariko Gate

description: Link starts having met Zelda, with her letter in hand, and Talon and Malon back at Lon Lon Ranch. Her letter's check holds the letter. Impa's check comes at the start (Zelda's Lullaby, unless Songs are shuffled), and Malon's does too when NPC gifts are shuffled. Zelda's Letter and the Weird Egg have been removed from the pool
label: Met Zelda

description: With Open, the Door of Time stands open from the start, so Link can grow up without the stones or the Song of Time. Zelda and Impa stay until he's met them. He skips Rauru, whose gift comes at the start, and can put the sword back any time. With Closed, it opens as in the game, once Link holds the three stones and the Ocarina of Time and plays the Song of Time
label: Door of Time

description: Jabu-Jabu's mouth is open, so child Link walks in without giving him a fish
label: Jabu-Jabu Open

description: The waterfall at the end of Zora's River already stands split, so Link reaches Zora's Domain without Zelda's Lullaby
label: Zora's River Waterfall Open

description: The debris in front of the Deku Tree's mouth is gone, so adult Link walks in and out
label: Adult Deku Tree

description: How the four carpenters in the Gerudo Fortress start. With Normal, Link frees all four, as in the game. With Fast, freeing any one frees all four and earns the membership card, and the other thieves still guard their cells. With Freed, all four are free from the start, with the membership card in hand, the guards standing down and the valley bridge up. Their thieves still stand, and beating one opens her cell without freeing anyone twice
label: Gerudo Fortress

description: What people hand over becomes a check: their gifts, minigame prizes, the House of Skulltula's rewards and the Great Fairies' upgrades
label: NPC Gifts

description: Ten songs become checks, given without the lesson: Zelda's Lullaby, Epona's Song, Saria's Song, the Song of Storms and Sheik's six. The Sun's Song, the Song of Time and the Scarecrow's Song stay where they are
label: Songs

description: What caps the Bombchus Link holds. The bomb bag's, as in the game. Their own cap of 40, so they open the same checks bombs do without waiting on the bag.
label: Bombchus

description: Turns on every skip below. Cutscenes that give an item, set a flag or move Link still play
label: Skip All Cutscenes

description: All small makes every chest a small one, which opens without the big chest's long animation. What a chest holds doesn't change
label: Chest Size

description: Navi never stops Link to talk on her own: the Lost Woods warning, dungeon and quest tips, and reminders. Hints you ask her for still work
label: Quiet Navi

description: Link runs half again as fast while he wears the Bunny Hood
label: Bunny Hood Speed

description: Child and adult Link can each wield every one-handed sword and every shield, and logic expects them to. Biggoron's Sword and the Giant's Knife stay adult Link's, and only he can aim the Mirror Shield at light
label: One-Handed Swords and Shields for Both Ages
